results.name: Malformed, oversized and null JSON have safe responses
Manager technical edits and signed identity edits are denied without mutation
Manager metadata cannot bypass a requested revision without an Assessor version
Concurrent first submissions preserve exactly one matching version
Missing fields, invalid identifiers, missing records and untrusted login role hints remain safe
Missing, forged, expired and wrong-role tokens cannot access sensitive APIs
Cross-Assessor and cross-Vendor access remain forbidden; Vendor responses omit internal data
Certificate stages enforce approval and ordering with immutable certified versions
Document MIME, base64, length, size, path and ownership protections remain intact
Unavailable uploads return safe errors and leave document metadata unchanged
Storage failures across read/write/export handlers expose only safe messages
Production unavailable-database behavior fails closed without touching local storage
Public honeypot and per-IP rate limit preserve stored data
Retired payment routes remain inert and public assets/private data boundaries hold
